title: Minimax Risk for the Quantile Treatment Effect Process under Vanishing Residual Selection
banked_reason: D0.5 field-floor failure: the delivered residual-selection envelope phase diagram is sound but substitutes for the promised source-compatible structural efficiency theorem; paper score ceiling 5.6 below 7.4.
gap_reasons: kernel_substituted@thm:local-selection-envelope-risk — The delivered headline is a direct residual-selection-envelope phase diagram attained by the raw observational QTE, not the promised source-compatible canonical-gradient/complete-all-threshold efficiency result with a uniformly attaining estimator and calibrated QTE process band.

The note does not deliver source-compatible semiparametric efficiency: there is no canonical gradient for the full CDF or QTE process, no solution of the continuous outcome-shape and categorical information equations, and no theorem establishing the advertised variance gain against the complete all-threshold bridge model.

The matched-envelope framing itself is faithful, but the elementary sensitivity-rate reduction, limited closest-literature comparison, and absence of an operational basis for validating the envelope keep the package below a field-level contribution.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved a matched n^-1 + a_n^2 risk phase diagram for a residual selection envelope, including sampling and observational-equivalence lower bounds and a conservative simultaneous band. D0.5 found that this replaces the promised repeated-surrogate structural efficiency problem: the canonical process gradient, feasible attaining estimator, complete all-threshold comparator, and strict variance gain were not derived. The reviewer graded the delivered package incremental below the field floor; no Lean formalization stage began.
tldr: For any prospectively fixed source-size schedule and deterministic residual-selection envelope \(\mathbf a=(a_n)\), the observational-population QTE process has matched squared sup-norm minimax risk \(n^{-1}+a_n^2\). The raw observational empirical-QTE process attains this phase diagram, and a conditional Dvoretzky--Kiefer--Wolfowitz band has finite-sample coverage at least \(1-\alpha\) with diameter \(O_P(n^{-1/2}+a_n)\). Sampling dominates when \(a_n=o(n^{-1/2})\), the two contributions meet when \(a_n\asymp n^{-1/2}\), and confounding dominates when \(a_n\gg n^{-1/2}\). The headline class permits uninformative proxies and is therefore transverse to published completeness-based persistent-confounding classes; binary repeated surrogates retain a finer paired-pencil boundary geometry, while exact Gaussian-quotient calibration remains open.
gap: Regular latent-structure analyses require separated eigenvalues, generic weak-function results omit the complementary two-source pencils and latent-label quotient, and weak-proximal QTE theory changes a different operator. Existing results do not characterize the local observational-population QTE experiment at a repeated latent selection eigenvalue.
fill: The project fixes the triangular array, quotient symmetry, compact rank-preserving class, local alternatives, observed-process loss, and a fully specified penalized data-only rule; it derives the paired-pencil experiment, proves matching process-risk bounds using an admissible explicit witness, and leaves only the exact simultaneous calibration as the first-class open problem.
